subject.title: fix(agent-core): preserve cacheRetention when undefined in harness options (#106014)

question: Should cache-retention precedence be owned centrally by the extra-params merge seam in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106069, or locally by this agent-harness option producer?
rationale: Both patches plausibly fix the shipped failure, but landing both would duplicate policy; repository architecture requires one canonical owner for precedence behavior.

options.title: Use merge-seam fix
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106069 because the wrapper that combines resolved configuration and request options can enforce the invariant for every caller.

options.title: Use harness-side fix
options.body: Land this PR if maintainers want option producers to omit undefined values and can prove every affected path reaches this producer.

recommendation.title: Use merge-seam fix
recommendation.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106069 because the wrapper that combines resolved configuration and request options can enforce the invariant for every caller.
